Entries.spring_4.002: Yana qancha vaqt kerak, doktor? Qornim ochdi.$s
Entries.marriage_Mon.001: Hoy, @. Bu yerda dam olishni yoqtiraman... Juda tinch.
Entries.marriage_Fri.000: Nima gap, @? Shunchaki onamni ko‘rgani keldim.

Entries.spring_4.001: Men shunchaki yillik ko‘rik uchun keldim! Xavotir olmang, homilador emasman... Ya’ni, kasal emasman! Xe-xe.$9
